column1: # RhinoTiger's words for a screen reader (fm1-reader): the text on the screen <TAB> what to say. "#" a number.
# tools/gen_words.py makes web/words/<id>.json (published with the site) and the link the FM-1 sends. Change a line
# and a new file is made: keep the old ones (devices in the wild point at them).
# "A" is the note: not the article (the reader says a capital A before a word as "a"), so ROOT A is one entry.
